payoff: Your local AI harness for Android.

assets.logo_monochrome: Android themed icon derives its alpha mask from the canonical H Bridge Core PNG symbol
assets.android_launcher: generated Android launcher resources synchronized from the canonical Harnex PNG masters

brand_mark.name: H Bridge Core
brand_mark.primary_meaning: Harnex is the connection layer between a consumer application and a local LLM/runtime
brand_mark.invariant: preserve the approved H Bridge Core geometry, three horizontal bridge lines, nodes, proportions and color treatment; do not recreate or reinterpret the symbol
brand_mark.android_role: secondary platform cue; Android must not dominate the H or the app-to-LLM connection

implementation_compatibility.policy: Existing Kotlin, Compose, Android resource and design-system identifiers may retain the Harness prefix until a separately scoped implementation rename is justified. They are implementation identifiers, not public product branding.

colors.primary: ui/design-system Harness purple primary semantic token
colors.focus: platform/Material focus indication using semantic theme colors

tokens.typography: ui/design-system HarnessTypography.kt and offline HarnessFontFamilies aliases
tokens.elevation: Material 3 semantic surface/elevation behavior through shared Harness components

style.iconography: Material/platform-appropriate icons with text or semantic cues for critical status; never color-only meaning
style.motion: restrained and purposeful; use motion only for feedback, continuity, spatial relationship, state transition, progress, attention, hierarchy or meaningful completion; never to compensate for unclear structure
style.imagery: functional technical product evidence, orientation, explanation, data visualization and bounded reference views before decoration; core workflows must remain understandable without decorative imagery
style.voice_microcopy: direct, specific, technical and privacy-conscious; name the operation/object, distinguish lifecycle states, give actionable recovery, and never overclaim evidence

durations.instant: immediate state update/no animation when continuity adds no user value
durations.fast: Compose/Material platform-default motion for frequent feedback; no Harnex numeric override
durations.standard: Compose/Material platform-default motion for ordinary state transitions; no Harnex numeric override
durations.large: Compose/Material platform-default motion for infrequent large navigation/continuity transitions; no Harnex numeric override

easing.enter: Compose/Material platform easing; no Harnex override
easing.exit: Compose/Material platform easing; no Harnex override
easing.move: Compose/Material platform easing; no Harnex override

spring.default: Compose/Material platform spring only when interaction semantics benefit; no Harnex override
spring.bounce: avoid bounce by default; allow only restrained use when it communicates meaningful completion

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: respect Android/Compose accessibility and animator-scale signals where available; prefer immediate or simplified transitions and never require motion to understand state or progress
